8. Defendants failed to pay OPEH the accrued interest on the Principal Amount on
September |, 2018, or within ten (10) business days thereafter.

9. Defendants failed to pay OPEH the Principal Amount on September |, 2018, or
within ten (10) business days thereafter.

10. Defendants owe OPEH $155,070 in accrued interest on the Principal Amount due
under the Promissory Note as of September 17, 2018.

Il. Defendants owe OPEH $2,233,007 as the Principal Amount due under the
Promissory Note as of September 17, 2018.

12. | OPEH delivered a notice to Defendants apprising them of the Events of Default
on September 25, 2018. A copy of the Event of Default Notice is annexed hereto as Exhibit B.

13. The Promissory Note states that “[dJuring any period an Event of Default has
occurred and is continuing after the expiration of any cure period, any amount of principal then
outstanding shall bear interest (the "Default Interest") at a rate equal to 15% per annum,
compounded annually. All interest shall be calculated on the basis of a year of three hundred
sixty (360) days for the actual number of days elapsed.” See, Section 7, Exhibit A.

14. The Promissory Note states that “[i]n addition to any other sums payable by the
{Defendant]s hereunder, in the event of an Event of Default, the [Defendant]s agree to pay [OPEH]’s
reasonable costs of collection and reasonable attorneys' fees incurred in the collection of the
obligations of the [Defendant]s under this Note and in the enforcement of any provision hereof,
whether suit be brought or not.” See, Section 14, Exhibit A.

15. No prior application has been made for the same or similar relief.
